```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Loading Packages
```{r load-packages, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(scales)
```

## Global Themes 
```{r global_theme, message=FALSE}
viz_theme <- theme_classic() + 
             theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black", family = "serif"),
                   legend.title = element_text(size = 12, color = "black", family = "serif"),
                   axis.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black", family = "serif"),
                   axis.title = element_text(size = 12, color = "black", family = "serif"))

```

## Importing Data
```{r data, message=FALSE}
# Subset data
data <- read.csv("data/s2_data_clean.csv")

# Meta-analyses
included_ma <- read.csv("data/ma_data.csv")
```

```{r use-indicators}
# Reading
ma_read <- included_ma %>%
  filter(out_reading == "Yes") %>%
  pull(ma_id, label)

ma_read

# Math
ma_math <- included_ma %>%
  filter(out_mathematics == "Yes") %>%
  pull(ma_id, label)

ma_math

# Meta-Analyses with Visualizations
ma_viz <- included_ma %>%
  filter(visualization == "Yes") %>%
  pull(ma_id, label)

ma_viz

# Meta-Analyses with Effect Transformations
ma_es_trans <- included_ma %>%
  filter(es_metrics == "Yes") %>%
  pull(ma_id, label)

ma_es_trans

# Meta-Analyses with Stakeholders
ma_stake <- included_ma %>%
  filter(stake_engagement == "Yes") %>%
  pull(ma_id,label)

ma_stake

# Meta-Analyses with Implications
ma_imp <- included_ma %>%
  filter(section == "Yes") %>%
  pull(ma_id,label)

ma_imp
```


# Basic Analysis

## Number of Documents by MA with Topic
```{r docs-by-ma}

# isolate columns needed
number_docs <- data %>%
  select(ma_id, label) %>% 
  mutate(ma_date = str_extract(label, "\\b\\d{4}\\b")) %>%
  group_by(label, ma_id, ma_date) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop")

# average documents per MA 
mean(number_docs$count)

# add outcome labels to color code
number_docs$outcome <- ifelse(number_docs$ma_id %in% ma_read, "Reading",
                     ifelse(number_docs$ma_id %in% ma_math, "Math", NA))

label_order <- number_docs %>%
  distinct(label, ma_date) %>%
  arrange(ma_date) %>%
  pull(label)

number_docs$label <- factor(number_docs$label, levels = label_order)

# build graph
docu_ma <- 
  ggplot(data = number_docs, aes(x = label, y = count, fill = outcome)) +
  geom_col() + 
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Accent", guide = guide_legend(title = NULL)) +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(count > 0, count, "")), 
            position = position_dodge(0.9), vjust = -.3, 
            family = "serif", size = 4) +
  viz_theme +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "bottom") +
  labs(x = "Meta-Analysis", 
       y = "Number of Citing Documents", 
       title = "")

# view graph
docu_ma

# save graph
# ggsave("visuals/docu_ma.png", docu_ma, device = "png", dpi = 600, height = 5, width = 7)
```

## Audience by MA
```{r audience-by-ma}
# isolate columns needed
aud_docs <- data %>%
  select(ma_id, unique_id, id, label, audience)

# view list of responses
# table(aud_docs$audience)

aud <- aud_docs %>%
  mutate(audience = str_replace_all(audience, 
                                  "Parents, community members, etc\\.",
                                  "Parents_community_members_etc")) %>%
  mutate(audience_list = str_split(audience, ",")) %>%
  mutate(audience_list = lapply(audience_list, str_trim)) %>%
  unnest(audience_list) %>%
  mutate(audience_list = str_replace_all(audience_list, 
                                       "Parents_community_members_etc", 
                                       "Parents, community members, etc.")) %>%
  filter(audience_list != "", !is.na(audience_list)) %>%
  mutate(value = 1L) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(ma_id, unique_id, id, label),
    names_from = audience_list,
    values_from = value,
    values_fill = 0L)

# calculate proportions
aud_count <- aud %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), sum), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "Category",
    values_to = "Count")

n_doc <- n_distinct(aud$id)

aud_prop <- aud_count %>%
  mutate(prop = Count / n_doc) %>% 
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(Category != "Practitioners")

# build graph
aud_viz <- 
  ggplot(data = aud_prop, aes(x = reorder(Category, prop), y = prop)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", fill = "#7FC97F") + 
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(prop * 100, 0), "%")), hjust = -.3, 
                size = 4, family = "serif") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = label_wrap(20)) + 
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL,
       y = 'Proportion of Studies', 
       title = "") +
  theme(legend = element_blank()) + viz_theme

# view graph
aud_viz

# save image
# ggsave("visuals/aud_viz.png", aud_viz, device = "png", dpi = 600, height = 5, width = 7)
```

## Presentation of Evidence by MA
```{r present-by-ma}
# isolate columns needed
present_docs <- data %>%
  select(ma_id, ma_id, unique_id, id, label, present, present_other)

present <- present_docs %>%
  mutate(present_list = str_split(present, ",")) %>%
  mutate(present_list = lapply(present_list, str_trim)) %>%
  unnest(present_list) %>%
  filter(present_list != "", !is.na(present_list)) %>%
  mutate(value = 1L) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(ma_id, unique_id, id, label, present_other),
    names_from = present_list,
    values_from = value,
    values_fill = 0L)

present_other <- present %>%
  mutate(reason = case_when(
      grepl("Q & A|interview", present_other, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "interview",
      grepl("abstract", present_other, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "abstract",
      grepl("Critique", present_other, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "abstract",
      grepl("no longer", present_other, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "unavailable",
      grepl("most of text", present_other, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "summary",
      grepl("mentioned", present_other, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "reference",
      `Reference list only` == 1 ~ "reference",
      `Table` == 1 ~ "table",
      `Visual` == 1 ~ "visual",
      `Bullet points` == 1 ~ "list",
      `Reference list only` == 1 ~ "reference",
      `Whole document is summary of MA` == 1 ~ "summary",
      `In Text - Other` == 1 ~ "in-text",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_)) %>% 
  mutate(reason = ifelse(is.na(reason), "in-text", reason))

table(present_other$reason)

filtered <- present_other %>%
  filter(Other == 1, if_all(where(is.numeric) & 
                              !any_of(c("Other", "Included with other references")), 
                            ~ .x == 0))

table(filtered$reason)


# calculate proportions
present_count <- present %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), sum), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "Category",
    values_to = "Count") %>% 
  filter(Category != "Included with other references") %>% 
  filter(Category != "Other") %>%
  bind_rows(tibble(Category = "Quote Only", Count = 4))

n_present <- n_distinct(present$id)

present_prop <- present_count %>%
  mutate(prop = Count / n_present) %>% 
  ungroup()

sum(present_prop$Count)

# build graph# buCountild graph
present_viz <- 
  ggplot(data = present_prop, aes(x = reorder(Category, prop), y = prop)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", fill = "#7FC97F") + 
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(prop * 100, 0), "%")), hjust = -.3, 
                size = 4, family = "serif") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = label_wrap(20)) + 
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL,
       y = 'Proportion of Studies', 
       title = "") +
  theme(legend = element_blank()) + viz_theme

# view graph
present_viz

# save image
# ggsave("visuals/present_viz.png", present_viz, device = "png", dpi = 600, height = 5, width = 7)
```

```{r stat-by-ma}
  group_by(stat_info) %>%
```

## Number of Documents by MA AND Use
```{r docs-by-ma-use}
# isolate columns needed
number_docs_use <- data %>%
  select(ma_id, label) %>% 
  mutate(ma_date = str_extract(label, "\\b\\d{4}\\b")) %>%
  group_by(label, ma_id, ma_date) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop")

# add labels to color code
number_docs_use$interest <- ifelse(number_docs_use$ma_id %in% ma_stake, 
                                   "MA Included an Interest-Holder",
                                   "MA Did Not Include an Interest-Holder")
number_docs_use$alt_es <- ifelse(number_docs_use$ma_id %in% ma_es_trans, 
                                 "MA Transformed Effect Sizes",
                                 "MA Did Not Transform Effect Sizes")
number_docs_use$viz <- ifelse(number_docs_use$ma_id %in% ma_viz, 
                              "MA Included a Vizualization",
                              "MA Did Not Include a Visulation")
number_docs_use$imp <- ifelse(number_docs_use$ma_id %in% ma_imp, 
                              "MA Included Implications Section",
                              "MA Did Not Include Implications Section")

label_order <- number_docs_use %>%
  distinct(label, ma_date) %>%
  arrange(ma_date) %>%
  pull(label)

number_docs_use$label <- factor(number_docs_use$label, levels = label_order)
```

## Description of effect
```{r description-by-ma}
# isolate columns needed
descrip_docs <- data %>%
  select(ma_id, unique_id, id, label, es_descrip)

# split and dummy code responses
descrip <- descrip_docs %>%
  select(es_descrip) %>% 
  mutate(es_descrip = case_when(es_descrip == "Other,No" ~ "No",
                                es_descrip == "Yes,Other" ~ "Yes",
                                es_descrip == "" ~ "No",
                                TRUE ~ es_descrip)) %>% 
  mutate(es_descrip = if_else(es_descrip == "" | is.na(es_descrip), 
                              "No", es_descrip)) %>%
  count(es_descrip, name = "Count") %>%
  mutate(prop = Count/sum(Count)) %>% 
  ungroup()



# basic graph

descrip_basic <- ggplot(data = descrip, aes(x = es_descrip, y = prop)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#7FC97F") +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(prop * 100, 0), "%")), vjust = -.3, 
                size = 4, family = "serif") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) + 
  labs(x = "Does Document/Citation Describe Effects?",
       y = "Proportion of Citations") +
  viz_theme


descrip_basic

# save image
# ggsave("visuals/descrip_basic.png", descrip_basic, device = "png", dpi = 600, height = 5, width = 7)

```

## ES Alt by MA

Not included in paper. 

```{r alt-stat-by-ma}
table(data$es_alt)

# isolate columns needed
alt_docs <- data %>%
  select(ma_id, unique_id, id, label, es_alt) %>%
  filter(!is.na(es_alt) & es_alt != "") %>%
  mutate(ma_alt = case_when(
      ma_id %in% ma_es_trans ~ "Yes",
      TRUE ~ "No")) %>% 
  group_by(ma_alt, label, es_alt) %>%
  summarise(Count = n(), .groups = "drop")

alt_prop <- alt_docs %>%
  mutate(prop = Count / sum(Count)) %>% 
  ungroup()

table(alt_prop$ma_alt)

# build graph
alt_viz <- 
  ggplot(data = alt_prop, aes(label, prop, fill = es_alt, color = as.factor(ma_alt))) +
  geom_col(position = "stack", size = 1) + 
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(prop * 100, 0), "%")), 
            position = position_stack(vjust = .5), 
            family = "serif", size = 4) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Yes" = "black", 
                                "No" = "white"), 
                     guide = "none") +
  labs(x = NULL,
       y = 'Proportion of Studies', 
       title = "") +
  viz_theme 

# view graph
alt_viz

# save image
# ggsave("visuals/alt_es_viz.png", alt_viz, device = "png", dpi = 600, height = 5, width = 7)
```

# PICOTS & Limitation by MA
```{r gen-by-ma}
data[data == "Other,Yes"] <- "Yes"
data[data == "No,Other"] <- "Other"
data[data == ""] <- "Not Applicable" 

table(data$population)

gen_vars <- c("population", "intervention", "comparison", "outcome", 
              "timing", "setting", "limitations")

data <- data[complete.cases(data[, gen_vars]), ]
table(data$population)

gen <- data %>%
  select(ma_id, population, intervention, comparison, outcome, timing, setting, limitations) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -ma_id,
               names_to = "gen_item",
               values_to = "response") %>%
  count(ma_id, gen_item, response, name = "count")

# Build graph
gen_viz <- ggplot(gen, aes(x = gen_item, y = count, fill = response)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  facet_wrap(vars(ma_id)) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  
gen_viz
```

# PICOTS overall
```{r gen-overall}
gen_all <- gen %>%
  filter(gen_item != "limitations",
         response != "Not Applicable") %>% 
  group_by(gen_item, response) %>%
  summarise(count = sum(count), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(gen_item) %>%
  mutate(prop = count / sum(count)) %>%
  ungroup()

gen_all$labels <- factor(
  tools::toTitleCase(as.character(gen_all$gen_item)), levels = c("Population", 
                                                     "Intervention", 
                                                     "Comparison", "Outcome", 
                                                     "Timing", "Setting"))


gen_all_viz <- ggplot(gen_all, aes(x = labels, y = prop, fill = response)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)) +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(count > 0, 
                               scales::percent(prop, accuracy = 1), "")),
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
                vjust = -0.5, family = "serif", size = 4) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#7FC97F", "#fee8a9", "#beaed4")) +
  viz_theme +
  theme(axis.title = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.title = element_blank())
  

gen_all_viz
```
